programs.title: Richard Hammond's Big!: Super Stadium
programs.desc: Richard Hammond goes behind the scenes of a new, groundbreaking football stadium to uncover how high-tech engineering created a cutting-edge innovation: a retractable soccer field that rolls back to reveal a world-first NFL field.

programs.title: Ballroom Blitz: International Grand Ball Championship
programs.desc: It's a showdown at the International Grand Ball  Carrie is a pancake-flipping farmer by day and a dancer by night, while Polish diva Natasha mixes business with pleasure.

programs.title: America's Worst Tattoos: The Artist Didn't Speak Good English
programs.desc: A tribute gone wrong  a scary story behind one tattoo  two identical, awful tattoos.

programs.title: Deadliest Catch: Run Silent Run Deep
programs.desc: Skirting the ice line to the deepest set of their careers, Josh and Casey apply frontier medicine to a bleeding deck boss.

programs.title: Alaska: The Last Frontier: Moving Mountains
programs.desc: Things get explosive when the Kilchers expand a road on their homestead with the help of detonation expert Desmond Duffy  Jane and Charlotte get stuck in the mud on a fishing trip  Atz Sr. and Bonnie brave the backcountry to salvage vital resources.

programs.title: Bering Sea Gold
programs.desc: With a massive storm about to hit, Shawn and Ken push their operations to the brink to get one last score in  Emily gambles on untested ground  Kris battles bad attitudes  one dredge pushes too far into the storm, forcing its crew to abandon ship.
